contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus. Gratian AD367-383. Mint: Arles AD 367-375 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads: [GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI]. Reverse: Emperor with standard and shield. Obverse legend reads: [....]. Obverse: Draped, Pearl diademed bust facing right. Die axis: 12 o'clock. Weight is 1.36g, diameter is 17.66mm
